# Flossie Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c11 P25](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0025), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P15](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0015)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c18 P20](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0020)</sub>

## Appearance

Flossie is a girl of heavy build. She has a spiteful grin and is known to turn as red as a beetroot when embarrassed.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014)_

## Personality

Flossie behaves dishonestly in school, sneaks looks at her books, and takes pleasure in the misfortune of others. She is moody when she fails to get her way and harbors spiteful feelings toward her classmates, particularly Nell. Despite her lack of creativity or imagination, she boasts about her own achievements and takes pride in her physical skills, such as balancing on fences.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P9](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0009), [v1 c23 P14](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0014), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P7](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0007)_

- Dishonest  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025)</sub>
- Spiteful  <sub>[v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047)</sub>

## Abilities

- Treading on wooden fences  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>

## Goals

- To outdo others in academic and social rivalries  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>

## History

Flossie attended the Brierley school, where she frequently cheated by looking at her books during lessons and held a bitter academic rivalry with her peers. She openly mocked Nell Harcourt for her red hair, leading Nell to break a slate over Hugh Carrow's head when Hugh teased her. Later, Flossie joined her classmates in taking lessons in the Fourth Book and eventually advanced to the Fifth Class. During a garden gathering at Isolde Pembroke's house, Flossie successfully navigated the narrow top of a wooden fence on a dare to show off her balance, after which she challenged Nell to walk the ridgepole of the kitchen roof, resulting in Nell falling into a Virginia creeper bush and breaking her ankle. Flossie was greatly relieved when Nell survived the accident. She grew moody when she was passed over for the role of the fairy queen in the school Christmas concert, though she participated in the rehearsals. In school competitions, she occasionally held the top spot in spelling, though she was eventually surpassed by Nell.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P9](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0009), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 c23 P18](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0018), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014)_
